rationale: The workflow already caches Node/npm dependencies via actions/setup-node@v4 with cache: npm, which satisfies the dependency-cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE); adding actions/cache would be redundant because an equivalent cache already exists. The workflow is a GitHub Pages deployment, so stale-run cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is contraindicated for release/deployment work, and concurrency already sets cancel-in-progress: false. There is no matrix for fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no scheduled workflows for schedule-related patterns, no tests to prioritize/select, and no measured baseline to justify a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) without risking valid slow runs. No other pattern's preconditions are met without introducing unrelated or risky changes.
